# jQuery 4.0.0

The full minified release is included as an offline fallback for Assignment 6.
The required CDN script in every page's head is the primary source.
`script.js` loads this local file only when the CDN is unavailable.

- Official download: https://code.jquery.com/jquery-4.0.0.min.js
- Release notes: https://blog.jquery.com/2026/01/17/jquery-4-0-0/
- License: MIT; see LICENSE.txt and the copyright notice in the source.
- SHA-256 SRI: `sha256-OaVG6prZf4v69dPg6PhVattBXkcOWQB62pdZ3ORyrao=`

This is the full build because the project uses jQuery effects and animation.
